accepted.prompt: Name a hero with an ability or ability upgrade that applies Silence to enemies.

validation.criterion: The hero's ability description or any upgrade (T1-T3) text explicitly says it applies Silence (or Silences) enemies. Examples from the data: Violet, Baba, Drifter, Celeste, Mina, Grey Talon, Lady Geist, Paradox, Warden, Ivy.
notes: Violet: "leaving causes them to take Spirit Damage and suffer from Silence and Slow, destroying the ink in the process."
Baba: "cycling over time in a random order between a soothing Combat Barrier, Silence, or scalding burn that deals Spirit DPS and reduces Spirit Resist."
Paradox: "Silences enemies for 2.3s +35% Weapon Damage"
Drifter: "Deals 55% Heavy Melee Damage Silences enemies for 2s if close range"
Lady Geist: "Silence enemies within 25m for 3s"
Grey Talon: "applying Curse and Movement Slow that interrupts, Silences, Disarms, and prevents item usage"
Ivy: "Silence for 3s on enemies hit. Increases damage and barrier scaling."
Celeste: "If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage."
Mina: "Unleash a cloud of bats that seek out targets, each dealing Spirit Damage and applying Silence."
Warden: "Silences enemies until they escape or are immobilized"

accepted.prompt: Name a hero with an ability whose base description says it applies Stun to enemies.

validation.criterion: The base ability description (not upgrade text, not base value lists alone) says the ability applies Stun to enemies, or that enemies suffer from or are stunned. Self-stun does not count. Examples from the data: Violet, Holliday, Abrams, Dynamo, Seven, Solomon, Infernus, Victor, Ivy, Grey Talon.
notes: Violet: "If the sketch is completed they take additional Spirit Damage, suffer from Stun, and drop a sketch that can be picked up."
Holliday: "Throw out your lasso, dealing Spirit Damage, Pulling, and applying Stun."
Abrams: "Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing Spirit Damage and applying Stun."
Solomon: "the queen releases squares in straight lines that deal Spirit Damage again and apply Stun."
Dynamo: "Create a singularity in your hands, dealing Spirit DPS, applying Stun, and pulling in nearby enemies."
Victor: "you reanimate, dealing Spirit Damage and applying Stun to nearby enemies."
Seven: "After a short duration, the static charge stuns and damages enemies within the radius."
Infernus: "Become a living bomb, dealing Spirit Damage and applying Stun to all nearby enemies after a delay."
Mo & Krill: "Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel."
Lash: "connected enemies are lifted and stunned then slammed into the ground."
Grey Talon: "which explodes on impact, damaging and stunning enemies."
Venator: "Enemies near a wall receive Stun and take Bonus Weapon Damage."
Ivy: "smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby."
Viscous: "deals damage and stuns enemies on impact."

accepted.prompt: Name a hero with an ability upgrade (T1-T3) that grants a Barrier or increases a Barrier.

validation.criterion: At least one upgrade line (T1, T2, or T3) of one of the hero's abilities explicitly mentions a Barrier, either granting one or adding to it, or improving its scaling. Examples from the data: Paradox, Wraith, Vyper, Ivy, Doorman, Paige, Solomon, Celeste, Warden, Mirage.
notes: Paige: "+100 Barrier and +2s Duration"
Solomon: "+80 Barrier +1 Stamina"
Paradox: "200 Barrier for 8s. Barrier scales with Spirit"
The Doorman: "Grants a Barrier first time traveling through doors"
Rem: "35% Bonus Item Range, Duration, and Barrier Effectiveness while napping"
Mirage: "Cannot be interrupted by damage Barrier gains Spirit Scaling"
Rat King: "Reduce all damage to a max of 250 +10% Max Health as Barrier"
Ivy: "On Fly End : 300 Barrier to Ivy and ally that scales with Spirit"
Celeste: "+70 Barrier and Increased Barrier Spirit Scaling"
Vyper: "On Slide: Gain 180 barrier for 4s"
Warden: "+30% Debuff Resistance and improved Barrier scaling"
Wraith: "300 Barrier for 5s. Barrier scales with Spirit Power."

proposal.prompt: Name a hero with an ability upgrade (T1-T3) that grants the hero bonus Fire Rate.
proposal.criterion: At least one upgrade line (T1, T2, or T3) of one of the hero's abilities explicitly grants a positive Fire Rate bonus to the hero or allies, such as +X% Fire Rate. Debuffs that reduce enemy fire rate do not count. Examples from the data: Violet, Apollo, Paige, Mina, Celeste, Mirage, Wraith, Ivy, Lady Geist, Victor, Sinclair, Deadman Danny.

notes: Violet: "On Empower: Gain +10% Fire Rate for 10s, stacking 5 times"
Paige: "On Barrier: +14% Fire Rate"
Deadman Danny: "On Backblast Hit: +18% Fire Rate for 7s"
Apollo: "Gain +25% Fire Rate and +25% Bullet Speed for 8s"
Victor: "While On Cooldown: Gain +15% Fire Rate and 6 Spirit Damage per Bullet"
Lady Geist: "On cast, +60 Spirit Power, +40% Fire Rate and +50% Spirit Resistance for 8s."
Sinclair: "+60% Fire Rate and +12.6 Assistant Damage"
Mirage: "+3m Move Speed and +20% Fire Rate"
Ivy: "+8% Fire Rate and +8% Bullet Lifesteal"
Celeste: "Spirit Amp per Stack +5, Fire Rate Per Stack +9"
Mina: "On Cast: Gain +25% Fire Rate for 8s and add 8 bullets"
Wraith: "+10% Fire Rate and +3s Duration"

proposal.prompt: Name a hero with an ability or ability upgrade that reduces enemies' Fire Rate.
proposal.criterion: The hero's ability description or any upgrade text explicitly reduces the Fire Rate of enemies hit, for example a Reduced Fire Rate effect or -X% Fire Rate applied to enemies. Examples from the data: Bebop, Kelvin, Sinclair, Rem, Warden, Solomon, Yamato, Pocket, Lash.

notes: Bebop: "apply Reduced Fire Rate to other nearby enemies"
Solomon: "On Hit: Reduce 25% Fire Rate for 5s"
Rem: "+2m Radius and applies -35% Fire Rate"
Kelvin: "Applies -20% Fire Rate"
Lash: "Apply -30% Fire Rate -16s Cooldown"
Sinclair: "Bolts apply -25% Fire Rate for 5s."
Pocket: "-32% Move Speed and Fire Rate for 4s"
Warden: "Applies -30% Fire Rate"
Yamato: "Slash enemies in front of you, damaging them and slowing their fire rate."

proposal.prompt: Name a hero with an ability whose base description says it Heals.
proposal.criterion: The base ability description (not upgrade text) explicitly says the ability heals, restores health, or provides Healing to the hero or allies, such as Heal, Healing, Heals, or Receive a Heal. Examples from the data: Abrams, Calico, Lash, Mo & Krill, Yamato, Warden, Kelvin, Dynamo, McGinnis, Lady Geist, Paige, Ivy.

notes: Abrams: "Drain health from nearby enemies, dealing Spirit DPS and Healing for a portion of the damage dealt."
Paige: "Healing allies and dealing Spirit Damage to enemies."
Dynamo: "While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby."
Rem: "Both you and the ally receive a burst Heal based on missing health followed by lingering Regen."
McGinnis: "Deploy a spirit that provides Healing to nearby allies."
Lady Geist: "Create a tether that drains enemy health over time and heals you."
Kelvin: "explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that Heals allies"
Mo & Krill: "Deal damage to nearby enemies and heal yourself based on the damage done."
Lash: "Strike enemies in front of you with your whip, Healing for a portion of the damage dealt."
Calico: "If the ability hits at least one hero, Heal a small amount of health."
Nurse Harrow: "Load your weapon with a full clip of syringes that Heal allies."
Ivy: "Heals you for a percentage of your max health."
Mina: "Receive a Heal for every target killed."
Warden: "heal you based on the damage done"
Yamato: "If any enemy heroes are hit, you heal."
